text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the deepening cold of December, Hanshin Racecourse was packed with overwhelming excitement.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Buena! We're counting on you!"
"You've definitely got this, Buena! Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Almost all of them were expectations for the 'heroine of the next generation'—Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under normal circumstances, the atmosphere would make anyone shrink back.
—And yet, she truly was 'special.'

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It echoes far and wide.
A melody of praise played by this very world, dedicated to you...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Now, which way did that person go...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Buena-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Desire-chan!
Nice to be working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Buena-san. I have long... looked forward to the day I could run alongside you."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah, me too!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You are the protagonist bathed in all the love of this world, shining so brilliantly...
No one would ever doubt your glory.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“—However.
What awaits you here today
is not a guaranteed victory.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Because destiny itself will be rewritten
by the holy maiden, Red Desire—!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Who's that girl...?
She just dashed straight toward Buena!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Well, from the looks of it, she's probably just holding a one-sided rivalry against Buena.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Today, I shall bring down you, my fated rival,
and take a massive step forward into another world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Please, steel your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I've been wanting to have
a real, serious race with you too, Desire-chan.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose. To answer the expectations
of everyone supporting me, I will win!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's Buena for you.
Thank you for pushing me to even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You are my greatest trial...
I shall overcome you without fail!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oh...? Sounds like Buena doesn't dislike it that much either?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"If she can even put up a bit of a fight against Buena,
things might get interesting!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire's confidence borders on blind faith.
Yet, it is carving a definitive mark into the atmosphere
dominated solely by Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The groundwork has been laid.
All that's left is to prove it with my running."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Please, watch over me until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —It is precisely because of adversity.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "For it shall serve as a fitting stage to display the prestige of Saint Red Desire—!"
